abstainFieldNote: Removed relative to the Stage 3C contract, per the Phase 8 decision. A field the training data cannot teach is a field the model will fill with noise.
legalityRule: Every emitted actionId is checked against the legal action set for that exact world before it is scored. A model output can never bypass legality: an illegal or unparseable answer is counted as such, never silently repaired into the nearest legal action.
